sections.title: Stations
sections.note: Stop at each station once to name it on the map. Temples and the Tower of Spirits aren't counted. Hidden ones need a Force Gem's tracks.

items.name: Aboda Village
items.howTo: Link's home village; you start here.

items.name: Castle Town
items.howTo: Below Hyrule Castle; reached on the first drive with Alfonzo.

items.name: Whittleton
items.howTo: Shown as ??? in the middle of the Forest Realm until you stop there, after the first climb of the tower.

items.name: Forest Sanctuary
items.howTo: Through the Lost Woods west of Whittleton: follow the trees at the first three forks and go against the fourth.

items.name: Rabbitland Rescue
items.howTo: An unmarked stop on the north-west line towards the Snow Realm, opened by the Snow Rail Map.

items.name: Anouki Village
items.howTo: The first stop in the Snow Realm.

items.name: Snow Sanctuary
items.howTo: Through the Rocktite's tunnel north of Anouki Village.

items.name: Wellspring Station
items.howTo: East of Anouki Village, on the tracks Steem's duet restores; it isn't on the map until you stop.

items.name: Bridge Worker's Home
items.howTo: The first stop entering the Snow Realm from the Tower of Spirits, open after the Snow Temple.

items.name: Trading Post
items.howTo: At the south-east of the Forest Realm, by the broken bridge to the Ocean Realm.

items.name: Papuchia Village
items.howTo: The first stop over the rebuilt bridge.

items.name: Ocean Sanctuary
items.howTo: East of Papuchia Village.

items.name: Goron Village
items.howTo: In the Fire Realm, opened by the Fire Rail Map; reached via the Snow Realm.

items.name: Goron Target Range
items.howTo: The first stop in the Fire Realm; closed for the eruption until the Fire Temple is cleared.

items.name: Snowdrift Station
items.howTo: At the end of the tracks Yeko's Force Gem adds in the north-west of the Snow Realm.

items.name: Slippery Station
items.howTo: At the end of the tracks Steem's vessel gem adds in the north of the Snow Realm.

items.name: Disorientation Station
items.howTo: In the north-west of the Fire Realm, on the tracks the Goron child's gem adds.
items.after: Force Gem: Goron child in Castle Town

items.name: Pirate Hideout
items.howTo: North of Papuchia Village, on the tracks Niboshi's gem adds.

items.name: Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: Where the Sand Realm track ends in the middle of the desert, after Anjean's Force Gem.

items.name: Ends of the Earth Station
items.howTo: In the far north-east of the Fire Realm, on Rael's new tracks.

items.name: Dark Ore Mine
items.howTo: On the east edge of the Fire Realm, on the tracks Ferrus's Ocean Temple gem adds.
items.after: Force Gem: Ferrus on the Ocean Floor

items.name: Lost at Sea Station
items.howTo: In the south-east corner of the Ocean Realm, on the tracks Linebeck's gem adds.

sections.title: Warp Gates
sections.note: Spacetime Gates: shoot the gem on a pair's triangle gate, then whistle as you approach either gate to warp. Letters as in the Prima guide.

items.name: Warp Gate A
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate south of Anouki Village (take the right turn at the first fork) with the Cannon. It links to the middle of the Forest Realm, north of Whittleton.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki lists Steem's duet as the requirement; Zelda Dungeon activates it on first entering the Snow Realm.

items.name: Warp Gate B
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate south of the Trading Post with the Cannon. It links to east of Wellspring Station in the Snow Realm.

items.name: Warp Gate C
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate east of Anouki Village, near the Bridge Worker's Home with the Cannon. It links to east of the Ocean Sanctuary.

items.name: Warp Gate F
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate south of the Goron Target Range with the Cannon. It links to the Ocean Realm, near the way down to the Ocean Floor.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon calls this pair D.

items.name: Warp Gate E
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate north of Aboda Village with the Cannon. It links to Goron Village in the Fire Realm.

items.name: Warp Gate D
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate north of Wellspring Station with the Cannon. It links to the Fire Realm.
items.after: Force Gem: Goron visits Anouki Village
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon calls this pair F. Zelda Wiki puts the other end near the Dark Ore Mine.

items.name: Warp Gate G
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate near the Pirate Hideout with the Cannon. It links to the Forest Realm near the Trading Post.

items.name: Warp Gate H
items.howTo: Shoot the gem on top of the triangle gate near the Sand Temple with the Cannon. It links to south of the Sand Sanctuary.
items.notes: Activate it during the three trials.
